+def format_hcl_text(text: str) -> str:
+    lines = normalize_hcl_lines(text)
+    align_hcl_attributes(lines)
+    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n") if lines else ""
+
+
+def normalize_hcl_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    out: list[str] = []
+    indent = 0
+    prev_top_close = False
+    for raw in text.splitlines():
+        stripped = raw.strip()
+        if not stripped:
+            continue
+        tokens = tokenize_line(stripped)
+        if not tokens:
+            continue
+        starts_close = tokens[0][0] == "}"
+        indent_before = max(indent - 1, 0) if starts_close else indent
+        line = ("  " * indent_before) + format_hcl_tokens(tokens)
+        if indent_before == 0 and out and prev_top_close and line != "}":
+            out.append("")
+        out.append(line)
+        opens = sum(1 for kind, _ in tokens if kind == "{")
+        closes = sum(1 for kind, _ in tokens if kind == "}")
+        if starts_close:
+            closes -= 1
+        indent = max(indent_before + opens - closes, 0)
+        prev_top_close = line == "}" and indent == 0
+    return out
+
+
+def tokenize_line(line: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
+    tokens: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(line):
+        ch = line[i]
+        if ch in " \t":
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if ch in ('"', "'"):
+            quote = ch
+            j = i + 1
+            while j < len(line):
+                if line[j] == "\\":
+                    j += 2
+                    continue
+                if line[j] == quote:
+                    j += 1
+                    break
+                j += 1
+            tokens.append(("STRING", line[i:j]))
+            i = j
+            continue
+        if ch == "#" or (ch == "/" and i + 1 < len(line) and line[i + 1] == "/"):
+            tokens.append(("COMMENT", line[i:]))
+            break
+        if ch in "{}[](),=":
+            tokens.append((ch, ch))
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        j = i
+        while j < len(line) and line[j] not in " \t{}[](),=":
+            j += 1
+        tokens.append(("WORD", line[i:j]))
+        i = j
+    return tokens
+
+
+def format_hcl_tokens(tokens: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> str:
+    out = []
+    prev_kind = ""
+    prev_text = ""
+    for kind, text in tokens:
+        if not out:
+            out.append(text)
+            prev_kind, prev_text = kind, text
+            continue
+        if kind == "COMMENT":
+            out.append(" ")
+            out.append(text)
+            break
+        out.append(space_between(prev_kind, kind))
+        out.append(text)
+        prev_kind, prev_text = kind, text
+    return "".join(out).rstrip()
+
+
+def space_between(prev_kind: str, kind: str) -> str:
+    if kind in {",", "]", ")", "}"}:
+        return ""
+    if prev_kind in {"[", "("}:
+        return ""
+    if prev_kind == ",":
+        return " "
+    if prev_kind == "=" or kind == "=":
+        return " "
+    if kind == "(" and prev_kind == "WORD":
+        return ""
+    if kind == "[":
+        return " " if prev_kind == "=" else ""
+    if kind == "{":
+        return " "
+    if prev_kind == "{":
+        return " "
+    return " "
+
+
+def align_hcl_attributes(lines: list[str]) -> None:
+    stack: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
+        stripped = line.strip()
+        if not stripped:
+            continue
+        indent = (len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))) // 2
+        if stripped.endswith("{"):
+            stack.append({"indent": indent, "indices": [], "max_key": 0})
+            continue
+        if stripped == "}":
+            if stack:
+                block = stack.pop()
+                for line_idx in block["indices"]:
+                    m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s=\s(.*)$", lines[line_idx])
+                    if not m:
+                        continue
+                    lines[line_idx] = f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2).ljust(block['max_key'])} = {m.group(3)}"
+            continue
+        if stack and indent == stack[-1]["indent"] + 1:
+            m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s=\s(.*)$", line)
+            if m:
+                stack[-1]["indices"].append(idx)
+                stack[-1]["max_key"] = max(stack[-1]["max_key"], len(m.group(2)))
+
+
+def load_config_env(config_url: str, env_name: str, raw_vars: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path = file_url_path(config_url)
+    if not os.path.exists(path):
+        raise AtlasError(f'config file "{path}" was not found: stat {path}: no such file or directory')
+    blocks = parse_config_blocks(path, read_file(path))
+    overrides = {}
+    for item in raw_vars:
+        if "=" in item:
+            k, v = item.split("=", 1)
+            overrides[k] = v
+    variables: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for block in blocks:
+        if block.type != "variable":
+            continue
+        name = block.label or ""
+        if name in overrides:
+            variables[name] = overrides[name]
+            continue
+        default = find_attr(block.attrs, "default")
+        if default is None:
+            raise AtlasError(f'missing value for required variable "{name}"')
+        variables[name] = eval_expr(path, default, variables, {}, env_name, "variable")
+    locals_map: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for block in blocks:
+        if block.type != "locals":
+            continue
+        for attr in block.attrs:
+            locals_map[attr.name] = eval_expr(path, attr, variables, {}, env_name, "locals")
+    for block in blocks:
+        if block.type == "env" and block.label == env_name:
+            result: dict[str, Any] = {}
+            for key in ("url", "dev", "schemas"):
+                attr = find_attr(block.attrs, key)
+                if attr is None:
+                    continue
+                result[key] = eval_expr(path, attr, variables, locals_map, env_name, "env")
+            return result
+    raise AtlasError(f'env "{env_name}" not defined in config file')
+
+
+def parse_config_blocks(path: str, text: str) -> list[Block]:
+    lines = text.splitlines()
+    blocks: list[Block] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(lines):
+        stripped = lines[i].strip()
+        line_no = i + 1
+        if not stripped:
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if re.match(r'^locals\s*\{$', stripped):
+            block_type, label = "locals", None
+        else:
+            m = re.match(r'^(variable|env)\s+"([^"]+)"\s*\{$', stripped)
+            if not m:
+                raise AtlasError(format_parse_error(path, line_no, 1, 2))
+            block_type, label = m.group(1), m.group(2)
+        i += 1
+        attrs: list[Attr] = []
+        while i < len(lines):
+            raw = lines[i]
+            stripped = raw.strip()
+            line_no = i + 1
+            if not stripped:
+                i += 1
+                continue
+            if stripped == "}":
+                i += 1
+                break
+            m_attr = re.match(r'^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.+)$', stripped)
+            if not m_attr:
+                brace = raw.find("{")
+                if brace >= 0:
+                    raise AtlasError(format_parse_error(path, line_no, brace + 2, brace + 3))
+                raise AtlasError(format_parse_error(path, line_no, 1, 2))
+            expr_col = raw.index(m_attr.group(2)) + 1
+            attrs.append(Attr(m_attr.group(1), m_attr.group(2), line_no, expr_col, raw))
+            i += 1
+        else:
+            raise AtlasError(format_parse_error(path, len(lines), 1, 2))
+        blocks.append(Block(block_type, label, attrs))
+    return blocks
+
+
+def format_parse_error(path: str, line: int, start: int, end: int) -> str:
+    return f"{path}:{line},{start}-{end}: Argument or block definition required; An argument or block definition is required here."
+
+
+def eval_expr(path: str, attr: Attr, variables: dict[str, Any], locals_map: dict[str, Any], env_name: str, context: str) -> Any:
+    text = attr.expr.strip()
+    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
+        return interpolate_string(path, attr, parse_string_literal(text), variables, locals_map, env_name, context)
+    if text.startswith("[") and text.endswith("]"):
+        inner = text[1:-1].strip()
+        if not inner:
+            return []
+        return [eval_expr(path, Attr(attr.name, part, attr.line, attr.expr_col, attr.raw_line), variables, locals_map, env_name, context) for part in split_top_level(inner)]
+    m = re.match(r'^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\((.*)\)$', text)
+    if m:
+        if m.group(1) != "getenv":
+            raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, attr.expr_col, attr.expr_col + len(m.group(1)), "Unknown function", f'There is no function named "{m.group(1)}".'))
+        nested = Attr(attr.name, m.group(2).strip(), attr.line, attr.expr_col + len(m.group(1)) + 1, attr.raw_line)
+        return os.environ.get(str(eval_expr(path, nested, variables, locals_map, env_name, context)), "")
+    m = re.match(r'^(var|local|atlas)\.([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)$', text)
+    if m:
+        return resolve_reference(path, attr, m.group(1), m.group(2), variables, locals_map, env_name, context)
+    if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", text):
+        return int(text)
+    raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, attr.expr_col, attr.expr_col + max(len(text), 1), "Invalid expression", "Unsupported expression."))
+
+
+def resolve_reference(path: str, attr: Attr, namespace: str, key: str, variables: dict[str, Any], locals_map: dict[str, Any], env_name: str, context: str) -> Any:
+    offset = attr.expr.find(namespace)
+    start = attr.expr_col + max(offset, 0)
+    end = start + len(namespace)
+    if namespace == "var":
+        if key in variables:
+            return variables[key]
+        raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, start, end, "Unknown variable", 'There is no variable named "var".'))
+    if namespace == "local":
+        if key in locals_map:
+            return locals_map[key]
+        summary = "Unknown local" if context == "env" else "Unknown variable"
+        raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, start, end, summary, 'There is no variable named "local".'))
+    if namespace == "atlas" and key == "env":
+        return env_name
+    raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, start, end, "Unknown variable", f'There is no variable named "{namespace}".'))
+
+
+def format_eval_error(path: str, line: int, start: int, end: int, summary: str, detail: str) -> str:
+    return f"{path}:{line},{start}-{end}: {summary}; {detail}"
+
+
+def parse_string_literal(text: str) -> str:
+    return bytes(text[1:-1], "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
+
+
+def interpolate_string(path: str, attr: Attr, text: str, variables: dict[str, Any], locals_map: dict[str, Any], env_name: str, context: str) -> str:
+    def repl(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
+        nested = Attr(attr.name, match.group(1).strip(), attr.line, attr.expr_col + match.start(1), attr.raw_line)
+        return str(eval_expr(path, nested, variables, locals_map, env_name, context))
+    return re.sub(r"\$\{([^}]+)\}", repl, text)
+
+
+def split_top_level(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    parts = []
+    current = []
+    depth = 0
+    quote = ""
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(text):
+        ch = text[i]
+        if quote:
+            current.append(ch)
+            if ch == "\\" and i + 1 < len(text):
+                current.append(text[i + 1])
+                i += 2
+                continue
+            if ch == quote:
+                quote = ""
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if ch in ('"', "'"):
+            quote = ch
+            current.append(ch)
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if ch in "[(":
+            depth += 1
+        elif ch in "])":
+            depth -= 1
+        elif ch == "," and depth == 0:
+            parts.append("".join(current).strip())
+            current = []
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        current.append(ch)
+        i += 1
+    parts.append("".join(current).strip())
+    return [part for part in parts if part]
+
+
+def find_attr(attrs: list[Attr], name: str) -> Attr | None:
+    for attr in attrs:
+        if attr.name == name:
+            return attr
+    return None
+

+def inspect_sqlite(url: str, exclude: list[str]) -> list[Schema]:
+    dsn = sqlite_dsn(url)
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(dsn, uri=("?" in dsn or dsn.startswith("file:")))
+    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+    try:
+        tables = []
+        for row in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY rowid"):
+            name = row["name"]
+            if any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, pattern) for pattern in exclude):
+                continue
+            tables.append(inspect_sqlite_table(conn, name))
+        return [Schema("main", tables)]
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+
+def sqlite_dsn(url: str) -> str:
+    raw = url[len("sqlite://") :]
+    if raw.startswith("file:"):
+        return raw
+    if "?" in raw:
+        return "file:" + raw
+    return raw
+
+
+def inspect_sqlite_table(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Table:
+    columns = []
+    pk_map: dict[int, str] = {}
+    for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({quote_sqlite_ident(name)})"):
+        declared = row["type"] or ""
+        default_sql = row["dflt_value"]
+        columns.append(
+            Column(
+                name=row["name"],
+                declared_type=declared,
+                hcl_type=hcl_type_for_sqlite(declared),
+                sql_type=sql_type_for_sqlite(declared),
+                nullable=(row["notnull"] == 0),
+                default_sql=default_sql,

def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        dispatch(argv)
        return 0
    except AtlasError as err:
        print(f"Error: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


def dispatch(argv: list[str]) -> None:
    if not argv or argv[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        sys.stdout.write(ROOT_HELP)
        return
    cmd = argv[0]
    if cmd == "version":
        if has_help(argv[1:]):
            sys.stdout.write("Usage:\n  atlas version [flags]\n\nFlags:\n  -h, --help   help for version\n")
            return
        sys.stdout.write(
            "atlas unofficial version - development\n"
            "https://github.com/ariga/atlas/releases/latest\n"
            "To download an official version, visit: https://atlasgo.io/getting-started#installation\n"
        )
        return
    if cmd == "license":
        if has_help(argv[1:]):
            sys.stdout.write("Usage:\n  atlas license [flags]\n\nFlags:\n  -h, --help   help for license\n")
            return
        sys.stdout.write(
            "LICENSE\n"
            "Atlas is licensed under Apache 2.0 as found in https://github.com/ariga/atlas/blob/master/LICENSE.\n"
        )
        return
    if cmd == "completion":
        handle_completion(argv[1:])
        return
    if cmd == "schema":
        handle_schema(argv[1:])
        return
    if cmd == "migrate":
        handle_migrate(argv[1:])
        return
    if cmd == "help":
        handle_help(argv[1:])
        return
    raise AtlasError(f'unknown command "{cmd}" for "atlas"\nRun \'atlas --help\' for usage.')

def parse_group_globals(args: list[str]) -> tuple[GlobalFlags, list[str]]:
    flags = GlobalFlags()
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        arg = args[i]
        if arg in ("-c", "--config"):
            flags.config = need_value(arg, args, i)
            i += 2
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--config="):
            flags.config = arg.split("=", 1)[1]
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg == "--env":
            flags.env = need_value(arg, args, i)
            i += 2
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--env="):
            flags.env = arg.split("=", 1)[1]
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg == "--var":
            flags.vars.append(need_value(arg, args, i))
            i += 2
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--var="):
            flags.vars.append(arg.split("=", 1)[1])
            i += 1
            continue
        return flags, args[i:]
    return flags, []


def handle_schema_fmt(args: list[str]) -> None:
    paths: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        arg = args[i]
        if arg in ("-h", "--help"):
            sys.stdout.write(SCHEMA_FMT_HELP)
            return
        paths.append(arg)
        i += 1
    if not paths:
        paths = ["."]
    for path in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            raise AtlasError(f"stat {path}: no such file or directory")
        if os.path.isdir(path):
            for name in sorted(os.listdir(path)):
                full = os.path.join(path, name)
                if os.path.isdir(full) or not name.endswith(".hcl"):
                    continue
                if format_hcl_file(full):
                    print(full)
            continue
        if path.endswith(".hcl") and format_hcl_file(path):
            print(path)


def handle_schema_inspect(global_flags: GlobalFlags, args: list[str]) -> None:
    url = ""
    exclude: list[str] = []
    fmt = ""
    i = 0
    while i < len(args):
        arg = args[i]
        if arg in ("-h", "--help"):
            sys.stdout.write(SCHEMA_INSPECT_HELP)
            return
        if arg in ("-u", "--url"):
            url = need_value(arg, args, i)
            i += 2
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--url="):
            url = arg.split("=", 1)[1]
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg in ("-s", "--schema", "--dev-url"):
            i += 2
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--schema=") or arg.startswith("--dev-url="):
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg == "--exclude":
            exclude.extend(split_csv(need_value(arg, args, i)))
            i += 2
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--exclude="):
            exclude.extend(split_csv(arg.split("=", 1)[1]))
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg == "--format":
            fmt = need_value(arg, args, i)
            i += 2
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--format="):
            fmt = arg.split("=", 1)[1]
            i += 1
            continue
        if arg in ("-c", "--config", "--env", "--var") or arg.startswith(("--config=", "--env=", "--var=")):
            local_flags, _ = parse_group_globals(args[i:])
            if local_flags.config:
                global_flags.config = local_flags.config
            if local_flags.env:
                global_flags.env = local_flags.env
            if local_flags.vars:
                global_flags.vars.extend(local_flags.vars)
            break
        i += 1
    if not url and global_flags.env:
        env_cfg = load_config_env(global_flags.config, global_flags.env, global_flags.vars)
        url = env_cfg.get("url", "")
    if not url:
        raise AtlasError('required flag(s) "url" not set')
    driver = url.split("://", 1)[0] if "://" in url else ""
    if driver != "sqlite":
        raise AtlasError(f'sql/sqlclient: unknown driver "{driver}". See: https://atlasgo.io/url')
    schemas = inspect_sqlite(url, exclude)
    if not fmt:
        sys.stdout.write(render_schema_hcl(schemas))
        return
    cleaned = " ".join(fmt.strip().split())
    if cleaned == "{{ json . }}":
        sys.stdout.write(render_schema_json(schemas))
        return
    if cleaned.startswith("{{ sql ."):
        sys.stdout.write(render_schema_sql(schemas))
        return
    if cleaned == "{{ mermaid . }}":
        sys.stdout.write(render_schema_mermaid(schemas))
        return
    raise AtlasError("unsupported format template")

def format_hcl_file(path: str) -> bool:
    original = read_file(path)
    formatted = format_hcl_text(original)
    if formatted == original:
        return False
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(formatted)
    return True


def format_hcl_text(text: str) -> str:
    lines = normalize_hcl_lines(text)
    align_hcl_attributes(lines)
    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n") if lines else ""


def normalize_hcl_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
    out: list[str] = []
    indent = 0
    prev_top_close = False
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        stripped = raw.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        tokens = tokenize_line(stripped)
        if not tokens:
            continue
        starts_close = tokens[0][0] == "}"
        indent_before = max(indent - 1, 0) if starts_close else indent
        line = ("  " * indent_before) + format_hcl_tokens(tokens)
        if indent_before == 0 and out and prev_top_close and line != "}":
            out.append("")
        out.append(line)
        opens = sum(1 for kind, _ in tokens if kind == "{")
        closes = sum(1 for kind, _ in tokens if kind == "}")
        if starts_close:
            closes -= 1
        indent = max(indent_before + opens - closes, 0)
        prev_top_close = line == "}" and indent == 0
    return out


def tokenize_line(line: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    tokens: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(line):
        ch = line[i]
        if ch in " \t":
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch in ('"', "'"):
            quote = ch
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(line):
                if line[j] == "\\":
                    j += 2
                    continue
                if line[j] == quote:
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            tokens.append(("STRING", line[i:j]))
            i = j
            continue
        if ch == "#" or (ch == "/" and i + 1 < len(line) and line[i + 1] == "/"):
            tokens.append(("COMMENT", line[i:]))
            break
        if ch in "{}[](),=":
            tokens.append((ch, ch))
            i += 1
            continue
        j = i
        while j < len(line) and line[j] not in " \t{}[](),=":
            j += 1
        tokens.append(("WORD", line[i:j]))
        i = j
    return tokens


def format_hcl_tokens(tokens: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> str:
    out = []
    prev_kind = ""
    prev_text = ""
    for kind, text in tokens:
        if not out:
            out.append(text)
            prev_kind, prev_text = kind, text
            continue
        if kind == "COMMENT":
            out.append(" ")
            out.append(text)
            break
        out.append(space_between(prev_kind, kind))
        out.append(text)
        prev_kind, prev_text = kind, text
    return "".join(out).rstrip()


def space_between(prev_kind: str, kind: str) -> str:
    if kind in {",", "]", ")", "}"}:
        return ""
    if prev_kind in {"[", "("}:
        return ""
    if prev_kind == ",":
        return " "
    if prev_kind == "=" or kind == "=":
        return " "
    if kind == "(" and prev_kind == "WORD":
        return ""
    if kind == "[":
        return " " if prev_kind == "=" else ""
    if kind == "{":
        return " "
    if prev_kind == "{":
        return " "
    return " "


def align_hcl_attributes(lines: list[str]) -> None:
    stack: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        indent = (len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))) // 2
        if stripped.endswith("{"):
            stack.append({"indent": indent, "indices": [], "max_key": 0})
            continue
        if stripped == "}":
            if stack:
                block = stack.pop()
                for line_idx in block["indices"]:
                    m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s=\s(.*)$", lines[line_idx])
                    if not m:
                        continue
                    lines[line_idx] = f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2).ljust(block['max_key'])} = {m.group(3)}"
            continue
        if stack and indent == stack[-1]["indent"] + 1:
            m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s=\s(.*)$", line)
            if m:
                stack[-1]["indices"].append(idx)
                stack[-1]["max_key"] = max(stack[-1]["max_key"], len(m.group(2)))


def load_config_env(config_url: str, env_name: str, raw_vars: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = file_url_path(config_url)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise AtlasError(f'config file "{path}" was not found: stat {path}: no such file or directory')
    blocks = parse_config_blocks(path, read_file(path))
    overrides = {}
    for item in raw_vars:
        if "=" in item:
            k, v = item.split("=", 1)
            overrides[k] = v
    variables: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for block in blocks:
        if block.type != "variable":
            continue
        name = block.label or ""
        if name in overrides:
            variables[name] = overrides[name]
            continue
        default = find_attr(block.attrs, "default")
        if default is None:
            raise AtlasError(f'missing value for required variable "{name}"')
        variables[name] = eval_expr(path, default, variables, {}, env_name, "variable")
    locals_map: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for block in blocks:
        if block.type != "locals":
            continue
        for attr in block.attrs:
            locals_map[attr.name] = eval_expr(path, attr, variables, {}, env_name, "locals")
    for block in blocks:
        if block.type == "env" and block.label == env_name:
            result: dict[str, Any] = {}
            for key in ("url", "dev", "schemas"):
                attr = find_attr(block.attrs, key)
                if attr is None:
                    continue
                result[key] = eval_expr(path, attr, variables, locals_map, env_name, "env")
            return result
    raise AtlasError(f'env "{env_name}" not defined in config file')


def parse_config_blocks(path: str, text: str) -> list[Block]:
    lines = text.splitlines()
    blocks: list[Block] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        stripped = lines[i].strip()
        line_no = i + 1
        if not stripped:
            i += 1
            continue
        if re.match(r'^locals\s*\{$', stripped):
            block_type, label = "locals", None
        else:
            m = re.match(r'^(variable|env)\s+"([^"]+)"\s*\{$', stripped)
            if not m:
                raise AtlasError(format_parse_error(path, line_no, 1, 2))
            block_type, label = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        i += 1
        attrs: list[Attr] = []
        while i < len(lines):
            raw = lines[i]
            stripped = raw.strip()
            line_no = i + 1
            if not stripped:
                i += 1
                continue
            if stripped == "}":
                i += 1
                break
            m_attr = re.match(r'^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.+)$', stripped)
            if not m_attr:
                brace = raw.find("{")
                if brace >= 0:
                    raise AtlasError(format_parse_error(path, line_no, brace + 2, brace + 3))
                raise AtlasError(format_parse_error(path, line_no, 1, 2))
            expr_col = raw.index(m_attr.group(2)) + 1
            attrs.append(Attr(m_attr.group(1), m_attr.group(2), line_no, expr_col, raw))
            i += 1
        else:
            raise AtlasError(format_parse_error(path, len(lines), 1, 2))
        blocks.append(Block(block_type, label, attrs))
    return blocks


def format_parse_error(path: str, line: int, start: int, end: int) -> str:
    return f"{path}:{line},{start}-{end}: Argument or block definition required; An argument or block definition is required here."


def eval_expr(path: str, attr: Attr, variables: dict[str, Any], locals_map: dict[str, Any], env_name: str, context: str) -> Any:
    text = attr.expr.strip()
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        return interpolate_string(path, attr, parse_string_literal(text), variables, locals_map, env_name, context)
    if text.startswith("[") and text.endswith("]"):
        inner = text[1:-1].strip()
        if not inner:
            return []
        return [eval_expr(path, Attr(attr.name, part, attr.line, attr.expr_col, attr.raw_line), variables, locals_map, env_name, context) for part in split_top_level(inner)]
    m = re.match(r'^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\((.*)\)$', text)
    if m:
        if m.group(1) != "getenv":
            raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, attr.expr_col, attr.expr_col + len(m.group(1)), "Unknown function", f'There is no function named "{m.group(1)}".'))
        nested = Attr(attr.name, m.group(2).strip(), attr.line, attr.expr_col + len(m.group(1)) + 1, attr.raw_line)
        return os.environ.get(str(eval_expr(path, nested, variables, locals_map, env_name, context)), "")
    m = re.match(r'^(var|local|atlas)\.([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)$', text)
    if m:
        return resolve_reference(path, attr, m.group(1), m.group(2), variables, locals_map, env_name, context)
    if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", text):
        return int(text)
    raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, attr.expr_col, attr.expr_col + max(len(text), 1), "Invalid expression", "Unsupported expression."))


def resolve_reference(path: str, attr: Attr, namespace: str, key: str, variables: dict[str, Any], locals_map: dict[str, Any], env_name: str, context: str) -> Any:
    offset = attr.expr.find(namespace)
    start = attr.expr_col + max(offset, 0)
    end = start + len(namespace)
    if namespace == "var":
        if key in variables:
            return variables[key]
        raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, start, end, "Unknown variable", 'There is no variable named "var".'))
    if namespace == "local":
        if key in locals_map:
            return locals_map[key]
        summary = "Unknown local" if context == "env" else "Unknown variable"
        raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, start, end, summary, 'There is no variable named "local".'))
    if namespace == "atlas" and key == "env":
        return env_name
    raise AtlasError(format_eval_error(path, attr.line, start, end, "Unknown variable", f'There is no variable named "{namespace}".'))


def format_eval_error(path: str, line: int, start: int, end: int, summary: str, detail: str) -> str:
    return f"{path}:{line},{start}-{end}: {summary}; {detail}"


def parse_string_literal(text: str) -> str:
    return bytes(text[1:-1], "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")


def interpolate_string(path: str, attr: Attr, text: str, variables: dict[str, Any], locals_map: dict[str, Any], env_name: str, context: str) -> str:
    def repl(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        nested = Attr(attr.name, match.group(1).strip(), attr.line, attr.expr_col + match.start(1), attr.raw_line)
        return str(eval_expr(path, nested, variables, locals_map, env_name, context))
    return re.sub(r"\$\{([^}]+)\}", repl, text)


def split_top_level(text: str) -> list[str]:
    parts = []
    current = []
    depth = 0
    quote = ""
    i = 0
    while i < len(text):
        ch = text[i]
        if quote:
            current.append(ch)
            if ch == "\\" and i + 1 < len(text):
                current.append(text[i + 1])
                i += 2
                continue
            if ch == quote:
                quote = ""
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch in ('"', "'"):
            quote = ch
            current.append(ch)
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch in "[(":
            depth += 1
        elif ch in "])":
            depth -= 1
        elif ch == "," and depth == 0:
            parts.append("".join(current).strip())
            current = []
            i += 1
            continue
        current.append(ch)
        i += 1
    parts.append("".join(current).strip())
    return [part for part in parts if part]


def find_attr(attrs: list[Attr], name: str) -> Attr | None:
    for attr in attrs:
        if attr.name == name:
            return attr
    return None


def inspect_sqlite(url: str, exclude: list[str]) -> list[Schema]:
    dsn = sqlite_dsn(url)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(dsn, uri=("?" in dsn or dsn.startswith("file:")))
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        tables = []
        for row in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY rowid"):
            name = row["name"]
            if any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, pattern) for pattern in exclude):
                continue
            tables.append(inspect_sqlite_table(conn, name))
        return [Schema("main", tables)]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def sqlite_dsn(url: str) -> str:
    raw = url[len("sqlite://") :]
    if raw.startswith("file:"):
        return raw
    if "?" in raw:
        return "file:" + raw
    return raw


def inspect_sqlite_table(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Table:
    columns = []
    pk_map: dict[int, str] = {}
    for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({quote_sqlite_ident(name)})"):
        declared = row["type"] or ""
        default_sql = row["dflt_value"]
        columns.append(
            Column(
                name=row["name"],
                declared_type=declared,
                hcl_type=hcl_type_for_sqlite(declared),
                sql_type=sql_type_for_sqlite(declared),
                nullable=(row["notnull"] == 0),
                default_sql=default_sql,
                default_hcl=hcl_default_value(default_sql) if default_sql is not None else None,
            )
        )
        if row["pk"]:
            pk_map[int(row["pk"])] = row["name"]
    primary_key = [pk_map[key] for key in sorted(pk_map)]
    indexes = []
    for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA index_list({quote_sqlite_ident(name)})"):
        cols = [idx["name"] for idx in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA index_info({quote_sqlite_ident(row['name'])})")]
        indexes.append(Index(row["name"], bool(row["unique"]), cols))
    fk_groups: dict[int, ForeignKey] = {}
    for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA foreign_key_list({quote_sqlite_ident(name)})"):
        fid = int(row["id"])
        if fid not in fk_groups:
            fk_groups[fid] = ForeignKey(
                id=fid,
                ref_table=row["table"],
                columns=[],
                ref_columns=[],
                on_update=row["on_update"].upper().replace(" ", "_"),
                on_delete=row["on_delete"].upper().replace(" ", "_"),
            )
        fk_groups[fid].columns.append(row["from"])
        fk_groups[fid].ref_columns.append(row["to"])
    foreign_keys = [fk_groups[key] for key in sorted(fk_groups)]
    return Table(name, columns, primary_key, indexes, foreign_keys)


def quote_sqlite_ident(name: str) -> str:
    return "'" + name.replace("'", "''") + "'"


def hcl_type_for_sqlite(declared: str) -> str:
    t = declared.strip().lower()
    if not t:
        return 'sql("")'
    if t in {"integer", "int", "text", "blob", "numeric", "real"}:
        return t
    if t.startswith("varchar("):
        return t
    if "(" in t:
        return f'sql("{t.split("(", 1)[0].strip()}")'
    return t


def sql_type_for_sqlite(declared: str) -> str:
    t = declared.strip().lower()
    if not t:
        return "blob"
    if "(" in t:
        return t.split("(", 1)[0].strip()
    return t


def hcl_default_value(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == "'" and value[-1] == "'":
        return json.dumps(value[1:-1].replace("''", "'"))
    return value


def render_schema_hcl(schemas: list[Schema]) -> str:
    lines = []
    for schema in schemas:
        for table in schema.tables:
            lines.append(f'table "{table.name}" {{')
            lines.append(f"schema = schema.{schema.name}")
            for col in table.columns:
                lines.append(f'column "{col.name}" {{')
                lines.append(f"null = {'true' if col.nullable else 'false'}")
                lines.append(f"type = {col.hcl_type}")
                if col.default_hcl is not None:
                    lines.append(f"default = {col.default_hcl}")
                lines.append("}")
            if table.primary_key:
                lines.append("primary_key {")
                lines.append("columns = [" + ", ".join(f"column.{name}" for name in table.primary_key) + "]")
                lines.append("}")
            for fk in table.foreign_keys:
                lines.append(f'foreign_key "{fk.id}" {{')
                lines.append("columns = [" + ", ".join(f"column.{name}" for name in fk.columns) + "]")
                lines.append("ref_columns = [" + ", ".join(f"table.{fk.ref_table}.column.{name}" for name in fk.ref_columns) + "]")
                lines.append(f"on_update = {fk.on_update}")
                lines.append(f"on_delete = {fk.on_delete}")
                lines.append("}")
            for idx in table.indexes:
                lines.append(f'index "{idx.name}" {{')
                if idx.unique:
                    lines.append("unique = true")
                lines.append("columns = [" + ", ".join(f"column.{name}" for name in idx.columns) + "]")
                lines.append("}")
            lines.append("}")
        lines.append(f'schema "{schema.name}" {{')
        lines.append("}")
    return format_hcl_text("\n".join(lines))


def render_schema_json(schemas: list[Schema]) -> str:
    root = {"schemas": []}
    for schema in schemas:
        schema_obj: dict[str, Any] = {"name": schema.name}
        if schema.tables:
            tables = []
            for table in schema.tables:
                table_obj: dict[str, Any] = {"name": table.name, "columns": []}
                for col in table.columns:
                    col_obj: dict[str, Any] = {"name": col.name, "type": col.declared_type}
                    if col.nullable:
                        col_obj["null"] = True
                    table_obj["columns"].append(col_obj)
                if table.primary_key:
                    table_obj["primary_key"] = {"parts": [{"column": key} for key in table.primary_key]}
                tables.append(table_obj)
            schema_obj["tables"] = tables
        root["schemas"].append(schema_obj)
    return json.dumps(root, separators=(",", ":"))


def render_schema_sql(schemas: list[Schema]) -> str:
    parts = []
    for schema in schemas:
        for table in schema.tables:
            cols = []
            for col in table.columns:
                piece = f"`{col.name}` {col.sql_type}"
                piece += " NULL" if col.nullable else " NOT NULL"
                if col.default_sql is not None:
                    piece += f" DEFAULT {col.default_sql}"
                cols.append(piece)
            if table.primary_key:
                cols.append("PRIMARY KEY (" + ", ".join(f"`{key}`" for key in table.primary_key) + ")")
            for fk in table.foreign_keys:
                cols.append(
                    f"CONSTRAINT `{fk.id}` FOREIGN KEY ({', '.join(f'`{key}`' for key in fk.columns)}) "
                    f"REFERENCES `{fk.ref_table}` ({', '.join(f'`{key}`' for key in fk.ref_columns)}) "
                    f"ON UPDATE {fk.on_update.replace('_', ' ')} ON DELETE {fk.on_delete.replace('_', ' ')}"
                )
            parts.append(f'-- Create "{table.name}" table')
            parts.append(f"CREATE TABLE `{table.name}` ({', '.join(cols)});")
            for idx in table.indexes:
                sql_name = table.name + "_" + "_".join(idx.columns) if idx.name.startswith("sqlite_autoindex_") and idx.columns else idx.name
                prefix = "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX" if idx.unique else "CREATE INDEX"
                parts.append(f'-- Create index "{sql_name}" to table: "{table.name}"')
                parts.append(f"{prefix} `{sql_name}` ON `{table.name}` ({', '.join(f'`{key}`' for key in idx.columns)});")
    return "\n".join(parts)


def render_schema_mermaid(schemas: list[Schema]) -> str:
    lines = ["erDiagram"]
    for schema in schemas:
        for table in schema.tables:
            pk = set(table.primary_key)
            fk_cols = {name for fk in table.foreign_keys for name in fk.columns}
            lines.append(f"    {table.name} {{")
            for col in table.columns:
                suffix = " PK" if col.name in pk else (" FK" if col.name in fk_cols else "")
                lines.append(f"      {col.sql_type} {col.name}{suffix}")
            lines.append("    }")
        for table in schema.tables:
            for fk in table.foreign_keys:
                lines.append(f"    {table.name} }}o--o| {fk.ref_table} : {fk.id}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def migration_files(dir_path: str) -> list[str]:
    if not os.path.isdir(dir_path):
        return []
    return sorted(name for name in os.listdir(dir_path) if name.endswith(".sql") and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(dir_path, name)))


def write_atlas_sum(dir_path: str) -> None:
    with open(os.path.join(dir_path, "atlas.sum"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(build_atlas_sum(dir_path))


def build_atlas_sum(dir_path: str) -> str:
    files = migration_files(dir_path)
    summary_lines = []
    for name in files:
        file_hash = hashlib.sha256(read_bytes(os.path.join(dir_path, name))).hexdigest()
        summary_lines.append(f"{file_hash}  {name}\n")
    root_hash = "h1:" + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256("".join(summary_lines).encode()).digest()).decode()
    out = [root_hash]
    for name in files:
        file_hash = hashlib.sha256(read_bytes(os.path.join(dir_path, name))).hexdigest()
        item_hash = "h1:" + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha256(f"{file_hash}  {name}\n".encode()).digest()).decode()
        out.append(f"{name} {item_hash}")
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def checksum_mismatch_detail(expected: str, actual: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
    exp = parse_manifest_entries(expected)
    act = parse_manifest_entries(actual)
    i = 0
    while i < len(exp) and i < len(act):
        if exp[i]["name"] != act[i]["name"]:
            break
        if exp[i]["hash"] != act[i]["hash"]:
            return exp[i]["line"], f'{exp[i]["name"]} was edited'
        i += 1
    if i < len(exp) and i < len(act):
        exp_names = [item["name"] for item in exp[i:]]
        act_names = [item["name"] for item in act[i:]]
        if act[i]["name"] not in exp_names:
            return act[i]["line"], f'{act[i]["name"]} was added'
        if exp[i]["name"] not in act_names:
            return exp[i]["line"], f'{exp[i]["name"]} was removed'
        return exp[i]["line"], f'{exp[i]["name"]} was edited'
    if i < len(exp):
        return exp[i]["line"], f'{exp[i]["name"]} was removed'
    if i < len(act):
        return act[i]["line"], f'{act[i]["name"]} was added'
    return 1, ""


def parse_manifest_entries(text: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    entries = []
    for idx, line in enumerate(text.splitlines()[1:], start=2):
        marker = line.rfind(" h1:")
        if marker < 0:
            continue
        entries.append({"line": idx, "name": line[:marker], "hash": line[marker + 1 :]})
    return entries


def file_url_path(value: str) -> str:
    return value[len("file://") :] if value.startswith("file://") else value


def split_csv(value: str) -> list[str]:
    return [part for part in value.split(",") if part]


def read_file(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()


def read_bytes(path: str) -> bytes:
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        return f.read()


def need_value(flag: str, args: list[str], idx: int) -> str:
    if idx + 1 >= len(args):
        raise AtlasError(f"flag needs an argument: {flag}")
    return args[idx + 1]


def has_help(args: list[str]) -> bool:
    return any(arg in ("-h", "--help") for arg in args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
